title: Faster, leaner agents with skill picks and a Metrics tab
idea: Find ways to improve the bot-herdr mod: (1) performance, (2) token efficiency, (3) skill discovery: the classifier should assign skills to each agent based on its role and the task at hand, also during the planning phase; skills are auto-discovered for all selected harnesses, and the user can also assign specific skills manually; (4) user experience, (5) agent experience, (6) turnaround time; (7) a metrics dashboard as a new tab giving insights into which agents work the most and by how much. Research first, then plan the improvements.
